result.reason: The redline includes the required mutual cap, listed uncapped carve-outs, indirect-damages exclusion, and payment-obligation clarification. However, the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, which can materially change the cap. In addition, the retained statement that the entire Section 15 limitation does not apply to Sections 13 and 14 may also disapply the indirect/consequential-damages exclusion, contrary to the preferred mutual exclusion and creating ambiguity with the new Excluded Claims construct. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted, although the semicolon within the Excluded Claims definition is awkward.
